navigation_prerequisites: A current authorized request; signed-in participant and unlocked vault; hosted delivery admitted for both participants.

actions.label: Choose PDFs from Drive
actions.meaning: The owner selects source file metadata with the official Drive picker. This does not authorize a hosted copy.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Authorize encrypted copies
actions.meaning: The owner reviews exact PDFs, price, deadline and the separate copy disclosure, then explicitly authorizes local source reads, watermarked previews, encryption and ciphertext upload.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Approve prepared copies
actions.meaning: The owner explicitly confirms the immutable encrypted document package and final delivery terms before the recipient can pay.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Accept document terms and pay
actions.meaning: The recipient explicitly accepts the approved version, price, deadline and rights, proves possession of the exact recipient key, then opens checkout.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Preview protected document
actions.meaning: The recipient explicitly opens a locally decrypted watermarked PDF preview under a current paid grant. Preview does not download a file.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Download watermarked copy
actions.meaning: The recipient explicitly downloads the locally decrypted watermarked PDF under current access. A completed browser handoff does not prove the file was saved.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Download original document
actions.meaning: The recipient explicitly downloads the exact approved original PDF, preserving its bytes and signatures. Downloaded copies cannot be recalled.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Close document preview
actions.meaning: Closes the active preview layer and erases its in-memory decrypted bytes, returning to the document list.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Request document key recovery
actions.meaning: The recipient explicitly sets up or recovers a vault-backed connector key and proves possession to request owner-authorized rewrapping of the existing purchase.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Repair recipient document access
actions.meaning: The owner explicitly rewraps the unchanged encrypted package to the recipient replacement key after verifying the paid package; this creates no extra charge.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Stop hosted document access
actions.meaning: The owner explicitly ends future hosted reads. Previously downloaded copies cannot be recalled.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Refresh document status
actions.meaning: Reads current delivery status and activity without changing consent, payment or the document package.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Stop Drive access
actions.meaning: The owner explicitly requests removal only of app-created Drive permissions. Existing access remains and reconciliation may be pending. Hosted One access is unchanged.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Stop both document channels
actions.meaning: The owner explicitly stops future One hosted access and requests removal only of app-created Drive permissions. Drive reconciliation may remain pending; downloaded copies cannot be recalled.

execution_target.reason: The visible document control owns explicit consent, current request binding and local vault effects.

actions.label: Choose document delivery method
actions.meaning: The requester manually chooses Google Drive, a secure One link, or both in the file request form. This changes only the draft delivery method: it grants no access to owner files, authorizes no hosted copy and submits no request. Secure One delivery also requires the separate activity disclosure; Drive delivery still requires the existing requester identity proof.

navigation_prerequisites: The file request form is open for an accepted connection, the requester is signed in with an unlocked vault, and hosted delivery readiness is enabled for this request.

execution_target.reason: The requester must choose the delivery method directly in the visible request form; choosing does not grant owner-file authority or hosted-copy consent.

actions.label: Open protected One link
actions.meaning: Opens the request-bound HTTPS One reader after final owner approval. The link grants no access, contains no file key, and still requires the approved recipient One account and unlocked vault.

execution_target.reason: The visible protected-link control binds the current approved request and checks the signed-in session. Link sharing grants no new access.

actions.label: Share protected One link
actions.meaning: Explicitly hands the request-bound protected One URL to the existing share sheet or clipboard. Forwarding grants no access or decryption authority and includes no file key.

execution_target.reason: The visible protected-link control binds the current approved request and checks the signed-in session. Link sharing grants no new access.

actions.label: Load newer document activity
actions.meaning: The owner reads one bounded page of activity after the last loaded event. Distinct visits remain separate. This changes no access, payment, consent or document package.

execution_target.reason: The visible activity control retains the current owner session and validated sequence cursor.
